mapper.select: SELECT user_id , user_no , user_name , user_tel , user_gender , birth_date, height, weight, a.area_id , b.node_full_name userRegion, address, user_avatar , user_status , reg_time, symptom, habits, medical FROM cust_userinfo a LEFT JOIN comm_area b ON a.area_id = b.area_id where user_id=#{userId}

SELECT sci.card_id, sci.card_no, sci.cat_id, sci.audit_company_id, sci.agent_name, sci.card_type_name, cc.company_name rep_company_name, CASE WHEN r.recharge_id IS NULL THEN '未兑换' ELSE '已兑换' END recharge_status FROM v_sale_card_info sci LEFT JOIN cust_user_recharge r ON r.card_no = sci.card_no AND ifnull(r.recharge_status, 0) = 1 LEFT JOIN comm_company cc ON sci.audit_company_id = cc.company_id WHERE UPPER(sci.card_no) =#{cardNo} LIMIT 1
